root.keyboard: ArrowDown/ArrowUp changes active option; Enter opens submenu
root.escape: closes root and restores focus to Filter trigger

valueMenu.open: click or Enter on a supported root option
valueMenu.selected: checkbox and aria-checked reflect current filter
valueMenu.commit: selecting first value closes both Portals, creates filter bar and changes visible issues

persistence.myIssues: localStorage per workspace/view; optional persisted view API
